    15  # Precoverages
    16  
    17  A precoverage `K` on a category `C` is a set of presieves associated to every object `X : C`,
    18  called "covering presieves".
    19  There are no conditions on this set. Common extensions of a precoverage are:
    20

    24  - `CategoryTheory.Pretopology`: If `C` has pullbacks, a pretopology on `C` is a precoverage that
    25    has isomorphisms and is stable under pullback and refinement.

    28

    30  - `CategoryTheory.Precoverage.IsStableUnderBaseChange`: The pullback of a covering presieve is again
    31    covering.
    32  - `CategoryTheory.Precoverage.IsStableUnderComposition`: Refining a covering presieve by covering

    12  # Cover-preserving functors between sites.
    13  
    14  In order to show that a functor is continuous, we define cover-preserving functors
    15  between sites as functors that push covering sieves to covering sieves.
    16  Then, a cover-preserving and compatible-preserving functor is continuous.
    17  
    18  ## Main definitions
    19  
    20  * `CategoryTheory.CoverPreserving`: a functor between sites is cover-preserving if it
    21    pushes covering sieves to covering sieves
    22  * `CategoryTheory.CompatiblePreserving`: a functor between sites is compatible-preserving
    23    if it pushes compatible families of elements to compatible families.
    24  
    25  ## Main results
    26  
    27  - `CategoryTheory.isContinuous_of_coverPreserving`: If `G : C ⥤ D` is
    28    cover-preserving and compatible-preserving, then `G` is a continuous functor,
    29    i.e. `G.op ⋙ -` as a functor `(Dᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A)` of presheaves maps sheaves to sheaves.

    34  * https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00WU

    55  /-- A functor `G : (C, J) ⥤ (D, K)` between sites is *cover-preserving*
    56  if for all covering sieves `R` in `C`, `R.functorPushforward G` is a covering sieve in `D`.
    57  -/

    59    cover_preserve : ∀ {U : C} {S : Sieve U} (_ : S ∈ J U), S.functorPushforward G ∈ K (G.obj U)

    62  theorem idCoverPreserving : CoverPreserving J J (𝟭 _) :=
    63    ⟨fun hS => by simpa using! hS⟩
    64

    66  theorem CoverPreserving.comp {F} (hF : CoverPreserving J K F) {G} (hG : CoverPreserving K L G) :
    67      CoverPreserving J L (F ⋙ G) :=
    68    ⟨fun hS => by
    69      rw [Sieve.functorPushforward_comp]
    70      exact hG.cover_preserve (hF.cover_preserve hS)⟩

    72  /-- A functor `G : (C, J) ⥤ (D, K)` between sites is called compatible preserving if for each
    73  compatible family of elements at `C` and valued in `G.op ⋙ ℱ`, and each commuting diagram
    74  `f₁ ≫ G.map g₁ = f₂ ≫ G.map g₂`, `x g₁` and `x g₂` coincide when restricted via `fᵢ`.

    76  `functorPushforward` used.
    77  -/
